source: segmentation (Blender simulation with background replaced by plain white)
time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 = t 0
units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale guessed

camera.motion: static (frames 0 and 28 differ only by segmentation edge noise on the truck outline; truck bbox constant 568..1288 x 380..867 in all frames)
camera.view: side view of the truck, horizontal camera; truck faces left (cab at left)
camera.ground_note: no ground or horizon is visible (white background); the wheel bottoms at y = 866-867 mark the ground line

objects.name: rocket
objects.description: slender grey rocket fired from the launch pod at the truck's rear; flies up and to the left in a straight line and leaves through the top edge of the image
objects.visible_frames: 3-25 (nose appears at the pod mouth in frame 3; partly inside the pod in frames 3-11; whole rocket visible in frames 15-22; cut by the top image edge in frames 23-25; gone in frames 26-28). Frames 0-2: hidden inside the pod
objects.reference_point: estimated geometric centre (midpoint of nose-tail along the axis) = proxy for the object origin

size_px.length_note: median nose-to-tail over frames 15-20 and 22 (individual frames 220.4-226.6; frames 14 and 21 read 235-237 because of a bluish plume/nozzle blob at the tail)
size_px.diameter_note: median mask width over frames 15-20 (16.5-17.8 px)
size_px.axis_aligned_bbox_full_rocket: about 183.5 x 153 px (w x h) while fully visible, frames 15-20

motion_path.type: straight line along the launch axis
motion_path.heading: up and to the left
motion_path.note: along coordinate in the csv: s such that position = axis_point + s * direction

objects.name: launcher_truck
objects.description: olive-green 6-wheel truck: cab at left, flat chassis, tilted launch pod at the rear
objects.body_length_note: front of cab (x=568) to rear mudflap/frame (x=1240), rows 760-867, excluding the overhanging pod corner
objects.root_proxy_note: the vehicle's root is not observable; the bbox centre is about (928, 624) and the wheel-axle midline is about y=821

objects.name: cab
objects.note: the top y=630 includes a small beacon; roof line is about y=640

objects.name: rear_wheel
objects.diameter_note: the Hough fit is probably low; the visible tyre spans about x=1100-1197 (about 97-100 px)

objects.name: launch_pod
objects.description: tilted grey-green box with a dark block at its upper-left end (the launch opening); raised at about 39 deg, parallel to the rocket's flight path

objects.name: launch_rail_arm
objects.description: thin L-shaped arm extending up-left from the top of the pod along the launch axis; the rocket slides along it

events.event: rocket nose first emerges from the pod mouth (launch seen)
events.note: motion starts at or before this frame; the start inside the pod is not observable

events.event: rocket tail leaves the pod mouth (fully out, release)
events.note: the tail crosses the mouth between frames 11 and 12 (estimated tail along = -394.6 at frame 11 and -357.0 at frame 12; mouth at -367.3)

events.event: rocket nose reaches the top image edge

events.note: last visible frame is 25 (only the tail, about 43 px)

events.event: no bounce, impact or direction change; the truck never moves

perspective: 2D side view: the rocket flies in a plane facing the camera, parallel to the truck's side; there is no visible change of depth, and the rocket's length and width stay constant (220-227 px, about 17 px) while fully visible
